reader.requirement: At 1985, a reference to a group holding a format 2 (DEPENDING ON) OCCURS uses only the current-count part of the table when data-name-1 is outside the group (either direction) or when the group is a sending item, and uses the group's maximum length when data-name-1 is inside the group and the group is a receiving item, for every statement that references the group.

reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb5776 covers STRING into a depending-inside receiver and pb202 covers reference-modified sending/receiving; plain MOVE in each of the four direction/inside cases, comparison, UNSTRING INTO and WRITE FROM/READ INTO are not in the witnesses

probes.printed: A1 [2AB       ] B1 GN=3 B2 [5VWXYZ] C1 [QQxycde] D1 [QQxyc     ] E1 EQ F1 [Z    de] G1 GN=3 G2 [5     ]

UNSTRING INTO an inside group receives at maximum length (GN becomes 4 from the data); WRITE FROM sends the current extent; READ INTO sends the record at its current extent
